_readme: FIAT ITEMS - the papers' picture rerolled (1 Nov, Matt). Written by tools/make_paper_reroll_manifest.py; the items' template. art/items/paper.png exists: run with --force.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life seen from above at a slight angle: a small loose bundle of old folded papers and envelopes, creased and damp-stained, the top sheet's corner curling, its lines only faint grey smudges with no readable writing, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no stamps, filling the frame. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no gun, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, no floor, wall, ground or sky around it, a plain dark neutral background.
